What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.16

  • In Music Mode, a new song changes everything at the same moment: the icons and widgets, the poster on your desktop, the notch's colours and the record in the notch. The poster now switches straight to the next cover between songs.
  • The notch, the Mirror and the Calendar wait a moment longer before opening, so passing by doesn't open them. Settings → Open speed sets how long.
  • Fixed the notch sometimes closing as the Mirror or the Calendar slid out under the pointer, and a drawer that had just opened not taking clicks until the pointer moved.
